name: 138. Provider endpoint updates require dashboard auth (provider-endpoint-updates) [SERIAL]
description: Management-plane regression for the default harness profile (tests/integrations/python/config.json, dashboard auth unconfigured, setup_token set). A caller with no credential must not be able to point the global proxy or a provider key's endpoint at a new host, and nothing may persist after the refusal. Under the OSS setup lock that caller is refused with 401 before the handler runs, so the write rows strip the X-Bifrost-Setup-Token header the harness injects: a request carrying the token is authenticated and is allowed, and its write would persist. No provider calls are made; the openai keyword is only a harness filter label. Under a profile with dashboard auth enabled the write rows return a 401 without the setup-lock message and fail loudly on purpose - run them against the default profile. The first and last rows clean up, with the setup token: they delete any harness-endpoint-guard key and, if the proxy URL is the sentinel http://127.0.0.1:3128 a refused write would have stored, restore the proxy captured at the start, so a write that gets through fails this run without poisoning other Azure rows or later runs.
